title: Saved Report CSV Export Handoff
purpose: Provide a structured handoff for enabling customers to export their saved reports as CSV, preserving the original request as context. This artifact distinguishes provided evidence from recommendations, assumptions, and unresolved unknowns; it does not authorize publication or implementation.

scope.text: Customers need to export their saved reports as CSV.

non_goals.text: No commitment is made here regarding exporting unsaved or ad hoc reports, since the source only mentions saved reports.
No commitment is made here regarding non-CSV export formats, since the source only mentions CSV.

requirements.text: Customers need to export their saved reports as CSV.
Report an observable error when CSV export fails; this failure behavior is a recommendation for review.

stories.text: As a customer, I want to export a saved report as CSV with column headers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer with access to a saved report, when they trigger CSV export for that report, then the system produces a CSV file representing the report's data.
Given a successful CSV export, when the customer opens the file, then the file contains column headers.

stories.text: As a customer, I want clear feedback when a CSV export cannot be completed so that I understand whether the request was denied or unsupported.
acceptance_criteria: Given CSV generation fails, when export is requested, then an observable error outcome is presented instead of silent failure.

edge_cases.text: Saved report is empty: CSV output behavior, including whether headers alone are produced, is undecided from the supplied evidence.
Saved report exceeds the maximum report size: exact cutoff and behavior at the boundary are unknown.
Customer lacks permission to export the saved report: the permission model and resulting behavior are unknown.
Report column names, data types, or special characters may affect CSV formatting; handling is not specified in the supplied evidence.

dependencies.text: Definition of maximum report size eligible for export is required before REQ-3 can be completed.
Definition of permission rules governing export is required before REQ-4 can be completed.
An owner and delivery date are needed for delivery planning; neither is provided in the source.

risks.text: Without a defined maximum report size, exports could consume excessive resources or fail unpredictably for very large saved reports.
Without defined permission rules, unauthorized users might export saved reports.
Absence of an owner and delivery date creates scheduling and accountability uncertainty.

success_metrics.text: Customers can successfully export saved reports as CSV, verified by acceptance criteria that a CSV file is produced.
Every exported CSV contains column headers, verified by acceptance criteria.

open_questions: Who owns delivery of this feature?
What is the delivery date or target milestone?
What is the maximum report size eligible for CSV export?
What permission rules govern who may export a saved report?
What should happen when exporting an empty saved report, and are headers still produced?
How should special characters, delimiters, encoding, and data types be handled in CSV output?
Should CSV export be limited to saved reports only, or also support ad hoc reports?
What specific error states and messages should be returned for oversized reports or permission denials?
